text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — PD-20345 — SEV: P1 — service: model-catalog-validator — Trigger: model_config_validation_failed for model_id=open-qa-v2 — brief: tokenizer mismatch vs pinned_revision. Link: https://pd.internal/reports/PD-20345

pagerduty: Automated page sent to schedule `eng-oncall`. Escalation policy: 0m -> primary, 5m -> L2.

maria: acked. i'm on triage, jumping in now. going to pull the latest catalog entry and diff against the pinned model. @raj if you can stand by for a potential rollback?

raj: oncall here, standing by. can you paste the catalog entry? i want to check tokenizer/revision fields.

maria: i pulled it already — looks like the catalog entry for open-qa-v2 was updated ~2m ago by the publish pipeline. snippet:```
model_id: open-qa-v2
revision: experimental-14
tokenizer: bpe
allowed_variants: [open-qa-v2-quant, open-qa-v2-int8]
```
but pinned revision in serving config expects:```
revision: 2026-03-12-rc3
tokenizer: byte_level
```
so mismatch in both revision and tokenizer. that explains the tokenization errors customers saw (token counts off -> generation 5xx / bad tokens).

sam: seeing spikes in errors on graphs — 5xx rate for model=open-qa-v2 jumped to ~32% at 02:10 UTC, latency rtts spiking, and a bunch of "tokenization error" entries in the runtime logs. attaching recent log lines:```
[02:12:14] runtime: tokenization error: unknown_byte_sequence at pos 34
[02:12:15] runtime: fallback_attempt failed: model_variant not compatible
[02:12:16] router: request->fallback returned 502 to client /api/generate
```

oncall-bot: PagerDuty PD-20345 acknowledged by maria. Next escalation at 02:15 UTC if not resolved.

raj: plan — immediate mitigation: pin catalog to last-known-good revision and trigger config reload on serving. if that fails, force-canary to variant 2026-03-12-rc3. executing rollback now:```bash
redwood-cli catalog set-revision open-qa-v2 --revision 2026-03-12-rc3 --confirm
redwood-cli deploy reload-config --service model-router
```

maria: running the CLI commands now. updating thread with results.

(30s later)

maria: `catalog set-revision` returned success. reload kicked off. health-checks show model open-qa-v2 back to ready on 3/3 replicas.

oncall-bot: config reload completed. post-deploy healthchecks: all green.

sam: monitoring — 5xx rate dropped from 32% -> 3% within 90s. latency normalized. can we mark customer impact reduced?

elaine: pinging CS/ops to notify affected customers. initial estimate: ~12 tenants who pinned to open-qa-v2 saw errors for ~3-5 minutes. flagging as potential support outreach. no data leakage alerts.

maria: root cause preliminary: publish pipeline accidentally overwrote `revision` field with an experimental build that uses a different tokenizer and wasn't validated. pipeline change earlier today removed a preflight tokenization check to speed publishes. new publish -> catalog entry points to experimental-14 which runtime doesn't have tokenizer compatibility for.

raj: follow-ups (short):
- revert the pipeline change that removed tokenizer preflight (raj)
- add schema enforcement in catalog service rejecting publishes where tokenizer != pinned tokenizer or where revision format doesn't match semver-like pattern (maria)
- add automated tokenization smoke test during publish that runs a quick tokenization check on a few sample inputs (sam)
- create PagerDuty rule mapping catalog validation failures to a lower-severity alert if they don't impact live traffic, but keep P1 for cases that increase 5xx > 5% (elaine)

maria: adding immediate mitigations: setting a temporary gate that requires manual approve for any publish that changes revision/tokenizer for models currently in production routes. will lift once automated checks are in place.

pagerduty: PD-20345 status updated -> resolved (auto) after ack and config rollback.

sam: leaving monitoring on for next 30m, will escalate if anything flares. metrics dashboard link: https://dashboards.internal/models/open-qa-v2

elaine: filing a post-incident ticket and scheduling a short blameless postmortem. assigning owner: raj (publish-pipeline rollback + fix) and maria (catalog schema + gating). target: patch + deploy within 48h.

maria: any objections to closing this thread? i will create the postmortem doc and link it here once done. :white_check_mark:

raj: no objections. thanks everyone for fast responses. lessons: re-enable preflight checks; add tokenizer compatibility test in CI; update runbooks to include immediate rollback command snippet.

maria: closing the loop — incident mitigated, customers notified, follow-ups created. will paste PM link when available. :thumbsup:
